description: This Java class 'DocumentsSample' is an Android activity demonstrating the usage of Android's DocumentsContract API for file and document management, including operations like opening, creating, renaming, deleting documents, and navigating document trees.

classes.name: DocumentsSample
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating various document operations via DocumentsContract API.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity UI with buttons for document operations and sets up their click handlers.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from document-related activities, performing actions like reading, writing, creating, renaming, deleting documents.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document with specified MIME type and display name.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message and optionally an exception.

methods.name: readFullyNoClose
methods.description: Reads an InputStream fully into a byte array without closing the stream.

methods.name: closeQuietly
methods.description: Closes a Closeable quietly, ignoring exceptions.
